sn35.147:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the way that is suitable for attaining Nibbāna.
sn35.147:1.3: “And what, bhikkhus, is the way that is suitable for attaining Nibbāna?
sn35.147:1.4: Here, a bhikkhu sees the eye as impermanent, he sees forms as impermanent, he sees eye-consciousness as impermanent, he sees eye-contact as impermanent, he sees as impermanent whatever feeling arises with eye-contact as condition, whether pleasant or painful or neither-painful-nor-pleasant.
sn35.147:1.6: He sees the mind as impermanent, he sees mental phenomena as impermanent, he sees mind-consciousness as impermanent, he sees mind-contact as impermanent, he sees as impermanent whatever feeling arises with mind-contact as condition, whether pleasant or painful or neither-painful-nor-pleasant.
sn35.147:1.7: “This, bhikkhus, is the way that is suitable for attaining Nibbāna.”
